quests.hint: React briefly, then think about what you'd want to know next.
quests.explanation: A brief reaction followed by a practical question makes you sound calm, not upset.
quests.partnerDialogue: Bad news, I'm afraid. The workshop is cancelled because the speaker is ill.
quests.sampleAnswer: That's a pity. Do we know when it'll be rebooked?
acceptedSynonyms: that's a pity. do we know when it'll be rebooked
oh no. is there a new date yet
that's disappointing. will it be rescheduled
that is a pity. do we know when it'll be rebooked
smartReplies: That's a pity. Do we know when it'll be rebooked?
Oh no. Is there a new date yet?
That's disappointing. Will it be rescheduled?
quests.correctAnswer: That's a pity. Do we know when it'll be rebooked?

quests.instruction: Ask for direction in an odd situation.
quests.hint: When nothing is clear, two things matter: how long, and what to do meanwhile.
quests.explanation: When the situation is unclear, ask two things: how long, and what to do meanwhile.
quests.partnerDialogue: Looks like the power's out in the whole building.
quests.sampleAnswer: Any idea when it'll come back? Or should we leave?
acceptedSynonyms: any idea when it'll come back? or should we leave
is it going to be long? should we go outside
do you know how long it'll last? should we wait here
do you know how long it will last
smartReplies: Is it going to be long? Should we go outside?
Do you know how long it'll last? Should we wait here?
Any idea when it'll come back? Or should we leave?
quests.correctAnswer: Any idea when it'll come back? Or should we leave?

quests.hint: Don't assume who is wrong. What would you do first?
quests.explanation: Checking first avoids an argument and shows you are open to being wrong.
quests.partnerDialogue: Excuse me, I think you're in my seat. I booked this one.

acceptedSynonyms: oh! sorry, let me look at my reservation
oh, really? let me check my ticket
sorry, i might be in the wrong seat. can i check
smartReplies: Oh! Sorry, let me look at my reservation.
Oh, really? Let me check my ticket.
Sorry, I might be in the wrong seat. Can I check?
quests.correctAnswer: Oh! Sorry, let me look at my reservation.

quests.hint: Describe what you do and exactly when it fails.
quests.explanation: A useful problem report includes the trigger: "every time I...".
quests.partnerDialogue: So what exactly is going wrong with the app?

smartReplies: The app freezes as soon as I add a picture.
Whenever I upload a photo, it closes by itself.
It crashes every time I try to upload a photo.
quests.correctAnswer: It crashes every time I try to upload a photo.

quests.hint: Give a timeline and say whether it's improving.
quests.explanation: Time plus trend ("a week, getting worse") lets a repair person decide how urgent it is.
quests.partnerDialogue: How long has the tap been leaking?
quests.sampleAnswer: A week or so, and it's worse now.

about a week. it's getting worse each day

a week or so, and it is worse now
smartReplies: About a week. It's getting worse each day.
A week or so, and it's worse now.
Since last Monday. Now it's dripping constantly.
quests.correctAnswer: A week or so, and it's worse now.

quests.hint: Tell them what you've already tried and how it turned out.
quests.explanation: Telling support what you've tried saves time and shows you've done your part.
quests.partnerDialogue: Have you tried switching it off and on again?
quests.sampleAnswer: Yes, I have. Nothing changed.
acceptedSynonyms: yes, i have. nothing changed
i did, but the problem came back straight away
yes, twice. it didn't help, unfortunately
yes, twice, it didn't help
smartReplies: I did, but the problem came back straight away.
Yes, I have. Nothing changed.
Yes, twice. It didn't help, unfortunately.
quests.correctAnswer: Yes, I have. Nothing changed.

quests.hint: Thank them, then explain the actual problem.
quests.explanation: With strangers, start with a short thanks, then say what the problem is.
quests.partnerDialogue: You look confused. Can I help?

smartReplies: Yes, please. The machine won't accept my card.
Thanks. I can't figure out how to buy a ticket.
I hope so. I can't work out this machine.
quests.correctAnswer: I hope so. I can't work out this machine.

quests.hint: Ask for feedback on one specific part, not everything.
quests.explanation: Asking for feedback on a specific part is easier to grant than "Can you check everything?"
quests.partnerDialogue: I've got a minute. What did you need?

quests.correctAnswer: Have a quick look at my slides? I'm worried about slide four.

quests.hint: Accept with enthusiasm, and make it easy by proposing a time.
quests.explanation: Accept an offer of help warmly, then suggest a specific time so they don't have to guess.
quests.partnerDialogue: I could help you move on Saturday. Would morning be okay?

That'd be great. Nine would be perfect, if that's not too early.
That would be fantastic. Could we say nine?
quests.correctAnswer: That would be fantastic. Could we say nine?

quests.hint: Give a real reason, not an excuse.
quests.explanation: Give a reason that isn't an excuse. Facts ("It went to spam") sound honest.
quests.partnerDialogue: Why weren't you at the meeting?
quests.sampleAnswer: I'm sorry. I didn't see the invitation. It went to my spam folder.

smartReplies: I'm sorry. I didn't see the invitation. It went to my spam folder.
My apologies. The invite ended up in my spam folder.
Sorry, I never got it. It must have gone to spam.
quests.correctAnswer: I'm sorry. I didn't see the invitation. It went to my spam folder.

quests.hint: Justify a habit by comparing two options.
quests.explanation: A comparison ("The bus is easier") makes your reason logical and easy to follow.
quests.partnerDialogue: Why do you take the bus if you have a car?

it is cheaper, and i do not have to look for parking

The parking costs a fortune. The bus is simpler.
Parking is so expensive downtown. The bus is easier.
quests.correctAnswer: It's cheaper, and I don't have to look for parking.

quests.hint: Personal reasons are the most convincing. Who is this for?
quests.explanation: People remember reasons connected to people. A personal reason sounds real.
quests.partnerDialogue: Why did you decide to learn Spanish?
quests.sampleAnswer: Mainly for my partner's family. They speak Spanish at home.
acceptedSynonyms: mainly for my partner's family. they speak spanish at home

smartReplies: I want to communicate with my partner's family.
Mainly for my partner's family. They speak Spanish at home.
My partner's family speaks it, and I want to talk to them.
quests.correctAnswer: Mainly for my partner's family. They speak Spanish at home.

quests.hint: Advice sounds friendlier when you mention your own experience.
quests.explanation: "That helped me" makes advice friendlier. It doesn't sound like an order.
quests.partnerDialogue: I can't sleep well lately. Any ideas?

Have you tried cutting out coffee after lunch?
quests.correctAnswer: Maybe try avoiding screens before bed. That helped me.

quests.hint: Sometimes the best advice is a question that makes them think.
quests.explanation: Sometimes the best advice is a question that helps them think.

quests.hint: Give the advice, then a reason that shows you're on their side.
quests.explanation: For sensitive advice, "you should" softened by a reason ("it's making you uncomfortable") feels supportive.
quests.partnerDialogue: My friend keeps borrowing money and never pays it back.

You should talk to him honestly. Say it's making you uncomfortable.
quests.correctAnswer: You should talk to him honestly. Say it's making you uncomfortable.

quests.hint: Recommend one and give a reason.
quests.explanation: A clear recommendation plus one reason is stronger than listing every pro and con.
quests.partnerDialogue: Should I get the cheaper phone with less storage or the expensive one?

I'd save the money. Extra storage isn't that important.
I'd get the cheaper one. You can use cloud storage.
quests.correctAnswer: I'd get the cheaper one. You can use cloud storage.

quests.hint: Give both sides without choosing for them.
quests.explanation: "X is..., but Y is..." is a balanced way to compare when you don't choose for them.
quests.partnerDialogue: Should we drive or take the train? I can't decide.

acceptedSynonyms: train is less stressful. a car lets us stop wherever we like

Train is less stressful. A car lets us stop wherever we like.
The train's more relaxing, but driving is more flexible.
quests.correctAnswer: Train is less stressful. A car lets us stop wherever we like.

quests.hint: Give an answer with a condition attached.
quests.explanation: "It depends on..." shows a thoughtful answer. Then name the deciding factor.
quests.partnerDialogue: Renting or buying: what do you think is smarter?

In the long run, buying. But not if you might move soon.
quests.correctAnswer: Buying is better long term, but renting gives you flexibility.

quests.hint: Show you care while you say no.
quests.explanation: "I wish I could, but..." is warm. It says no while showing you care.

quests.hint: Refuse the food, not the person.
quests.explanation: Refuse the food, not the person. A compliment or thanks protects the relationship.

quests.hint: Take responsibility quickly and offer a fix.

I didn't mean that. I'd love to come, but I have work.
quests.correctAnswer: No, that's not what I meant. I do want to, but I'm working late.

quests.hint: One general question, one specific question.

quests.hint: Act first, then apologize briefly.
